facts.value: With an item, samples attachment position and consumes throw_flags_b3 once. If unset, caches the sample. Release position is current + (-cmd_timer/frame_speed_mul)*(cached-current), with Z0 and no local clamp/zero-divisor guard. Motion table x8 times heavy_throw_velocity_multiplier scales the separate scalar. Reports release. LightThrowDrop uses dropped API; all other motions use thrown API with Boolean motion>=LightThrowF4 and weight-selected rumble27/29 versus26/28.
